carryOver.title: MTB3A has a new address

lead.one: This browser holds {count} record from this app. Carry it to the new address to keep using it there.
lead.other: This browser holds {count} records from this app. Carry them to the new address to keep using them there.

carryOver.later: Keep using the old app for now
carryOver.laterNote: This app is being retired. Records you add here won't follow unless you carry them over again.
carryOver.waiting: Finish on the new page that opened…
carryOver.installedLead: You opened MTB3A from your home screen. Download your records file, then open {address} in your browser and choose Your data › Restore from file.
carryOver.fallback: The new page couldn't be reached. Download your records file, then open {address} and choose Your data › Restore from file.
carryOver.failed: The new address couldn't check or save your records, so nothing was carried. Download your records file, then open {address} and choose Your data › Restore from file.
carryOver.declined: Nothing was carried over. Your records are still here.
carryOver.done: Your records are on the new address.
carryOver.banner: Your records were carried to {address} on {date}. Changes you make here won't follow.
